deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy to prod-us-west for tag v2.4.1 (commit abcdef1)
ci-bot: CI gate: running checks (unit, integration, e2e, lint)
ci-bot: CI gate: blocked — failing checks detected: service/ingest:unit-tests (1/120 failed) :rotating_light:
rachel: :eyes: seeing the same in the build logs, attaching snippet
rachel: ```
=== FAIL: test_ingest_batch (tests/test_ingest.py:48)
E   AssertionError: 200 != 500
E   AssertionError: expected status 200 got 500
E   File "redwood/ingest/handler.py", line 142, in handle_batch
E       process_batch(batch)
```
alex: Is this a known flaky? QA said staging passed this morning
marta: staging green earlier. suspect environment-dependent flake (DB timeout)
jamie: Prefer not to manual-skip gates. Options: rerun CI, hotfix the failing assertion, or rollback canary to v2.4.0
alex: Agreed. I'm okay with a single retry. If it fails again, rollback.
marta: Kicking off a retry now — /ci retry pipeline#8421 (targeting only unit-tests)
ci-bot: Retry queued: pipeline #8421 -> attempt 2 (triggered by marta)
deploy-bot: Canary deploy paused (blocked by CI gate). Will resume automatically if gate passes or on manual override by release lead.
rachel: tagging @oncall-release for visibility :loud_sound:
jamie: Adding note to release channel: canary hold due to ingest unit-test failure, tracking in ops ticket #INC-457
ci-bot: Pipeline #8421 attempt 2: completed — FAILED (same test failed)
rachel: Ugh, reproduced. Logs show 500 from ingest handler on batch boundary, looks like an NPE when batch size == 0
alex: OK, initiate rollback to v2.4.0 and pin the next canary until we get a fix out
jamie: Deploy lead authorization requested: @alex (please confirm rollback)
alex: Confirmed. Proceed with rollback.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback: reverting canary instances in prod-us-west to tag v2.4.0 (commit fedcba9)
ci-bot: Note: this rollback is recorded in pipeline audit (id: rollback-1748003456)
deploy-bot: Rollback complete — canary instances now on v2.4.0. No further traffic shifts applied. :white_check_mark:
marta: Opening a PR to add defensive checks and to reproduce the failure locally (link: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/209)
rachel: I'll coordinate a postmortem and include the failing test output + environment dump
jamie: Putting a temporary rule in release playbook: retry CI once for suspected flake, then rollback if still failing. We'll revisit after postmortem.
alex: Filed follow-up task to pin model and add stricter DB timeouts for ingest (TASK-1058)
rachel: Thanks all — closing thread once postmortem doc is up.
